name: leaguelens
description: View your fantasy rosters across sports + providers in one hub

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker "npm run dev -w @leaguelens/frontend" "npm run dev:api -w @leaguelens/backend" "npm run dev:worker -w @leaguelens/backend"
scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run build -w @leaguelens/shared && npm run build -w @leaguelens/backend && npm run build -w @leaguelens/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run codegen && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
